about.title: Advancing Destination Earth with Next-Generation Satellite Intelligence
about.text: The European Union has launched CLEAR-EO, an ambitious research and innovation project that will leverage newly available satellite missions – including Meteosat Third Generation and the EUMETSAT Polar System Second Generation – alongside European cloud infrastructures such as the European Weather Cloud, to provide new critical services to communities around Europe.
about.quote: “CLEAR-EO is about turning space data into concrete solutions for society,” says Paolo Viviani.

pillars.title: How we deliver
pillars.text: CLEAR‑EO teams up a multidisciplinary partnership — from research organizations, weather forecasting centres, EO data specialists and cloud platform experts to GEO and DestinE contributors — to develop, demonstrate, and promote new applications and the early exploitation of new weather satellite data. Our work supports the SDGs and the European Green Deal.

pillars.title: Next-gen satellites
pillars.text: CLEAR‑EO leverages newly available satellite data like Meteosat Third Generation and EUMETSAT Polar System Second Generation, along with European cloud infrastructures such as the European Weather Cloud.

pillars.title: Virtual Observatory
pillars.text: The Virtual Observatory is a digital platform being developed to connect diverse environmental data with real-world applications through smart geospatial alerts that will support faster response to extreme events.

pillars.title: Decision‑ready outputs
pillars.text: On‑demand workflows for floods, agricultural adaptation, and air quality forecasting.

observatory.title: A digital platform for application triggering and orchestration, bridging diverse data sources with real-world applications.
observatory.text: It runs innovative processing chains — covering phenomena such as rainfall and drought — brokers geo-fenced notifications of relevant events, and triggers downstream applications on demand. The goal is to deliver timely, actionable alerts to both developers and end users, ultimately supporting faster and better-informed decision-making.

steps.title: Federated data space
steps.text: CLEAR-EO builds a federated data space that provides scalable data governance component for the project to be fully integrated with the internal and external resources in terms of data, applications, computational resources and European data ecosystems.

steps.title: Computational resources
steps.text: The CLEAR-EO infrastructure is distributed and heterogeneous, combining cloud, HPC, and on-premise/private facilities, while remaining sovereign by relying exclusively on EU cloud providers.

steps.title: Geo-spatial notification system
steps.text: AVISO notifies users when relevant events occur, orchestrates downstream modelling, and will be extended to support geo-localized event alerts.

observatory.note_text: AVISO is the geo-spatial notification system at the heart of the CLEAR-EO Virtual Observatory. The system follows a producer–consumer model: producers post notifications specifying the event type and the affected geographic area, while consumers subscribe to event categories within regions of interest and can integrate the client either as a library or a standalone process capable of scheduling further workflows.

footer.title: From space to actionable insight
